chapter: New Orleans teachers and classical musicians
title: Papa Tio's conducting and his opera orchestra
summary: Tio directed heavy overtures and operas well; Russell asks about the musicians in his orchestra.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands

blocks.x: Okay, you were talking about, you mentioned first of all that at the end of the other reel about old man Tio, Papa Tio, used a bad tone when he conducted.
He used a bad tone when he directed.
What kind of an orchestra did he conduct? Do you remember hearing any concerts?
Well yeah, he played all those heavy overtures, operas, you know opera numbers. He conducted them beautiful too. He really was marvelous to them. I think he was the greatest in the awards.
And the musicians who were in his big orchestra?
